# Ismat Duckson Aziz

> Ismat Duckson Aziz is a Fortune 500 Chief Human Resources Officer, board director, and McKinsey & Company senior advisor who helps CEOs, boards, and executive teams lead large-scale, AI-era transformation without losing the workforce along the way.

## About
- 25+ years leading human capital across five Fortune 500 companies (CHRO and Chief Administrative Officer roles)
- Senior Advisor, McKinsey & Company (Global Transformation Office)
- Board Director, Homethrive; Corporate Director in Residence, Woman Get On Board
- Instructor and Executive in Residence, Duke University Fuqua School of Business; Dean's Advisory Board, Rotman School (University of Toronto)
- Recognized as a Reuters Events Trailblazing Woman in Insurance (2024)
- Credentials: MBA, Chartered Director (C.Dir.)

## Ways to work with her
- Enterprise and transformation advisory (the people side of large-scale change, M&A integration, AI adoption)
- Board and governance (independent director and committee service)
- Keynotes and speaking (the modern CHRO, technology and the workforce)
- Executive mentorship and CHRO development
